crossRefs.note: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’
(the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

translations.web: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
translations.bsb: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.
translations.kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
translations.asv: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.
